svg.aria-label: How each corner of the regular octagon is smoothed, with the octagon of inradius 1, side k on ℓ_k: x cos(kπ/4) + y sin(kπ/4) = 1. The corner of ℓ₀: x = 1 and ℓ₁: x + y = √2 is replaced by an arc of the hyperbola (1 − y)(√2 − x + y) = ½: the product of the distances to the two dashed lines ℓ₂: y = 1 and ℓ₇: x − y = √2, its asymptotes, is constant. They meet at its centre C = (1 + √2, 1). The arc touches the sides at T₁ = (1, 1 − 1/√2) and T₂ = (√2 − ½, ½); right, the corner magnified ×4. Bottom right: the distances d₂ = 1 − y and d₇ = (√2 − x + y)/√2, drawn for one point of the arc, and d₂ · d₇ = √2/4, the value that makes the curve touch both sides
